page.layout: One column of running text, set in roman with italics; in the left margin a few short marginal notes (Hebr./Deut./Rom. references, a sidenote "De Deo Patre" and "Argumenta Diuina"); a catchword-like word "fuo" at the lower right. Running head at top: "Merindolii incolæ. ACT. MARTYRVM," (left and right parts). No page number printed.

main_text.l: tegritatem operum paratus sit. Hinc consequitur, Scripturæ sanctæ
volumina satis esse fusa ampláque ad restituendam salutem hominibus:
ad verum Dei cultum illustrandum: ad depellendum errorem eorum
qui oppugnant veritatem: ad hæreses & vitia, deprauatósque homi-
num censendos atque corrigendos mores. His de causis sanctæ Scrip-
turæ scientiam auro & gemmis longè magis expetendam esse: eiúsque
disciplina omne hominum genus ad præceptorum omnium obseruatio-
nem erudiri, ad eius lectionem assuefieri oportere. Nec verò quicquam
esse tentandum extra cancellos verbi Dei, cui nec adiungendum ali-
quid, nec detrahendum omnino sit: ne qua Dei animaduersio in nos, aut
impostoria noxa maximo hominum incommodo consequatur.
Ex eiusdem Scripturæ disciplina confitemur, & credimus in vnum
Deum, Patrem, Filium & Spiritum sanctum, tribus distinctum perso-
nis, sed eadem vna, spirituali, æquabili, perpetua, nullum neque prin-
cipium, neque diuinitatis exitum habente essentia præditum: qui ma-
xima potentia sua, infinitáque bonitate creat omnia, eáque vegetet,
tueatur, & conseruet.
Et quanquam maiestas eius est plané tanta, vt
eam in hac humanæ vitæ luce, cogitatione nullo modo consequi pos-
simus (quicunque enim eam inuestigare supra sortem humanæ condi-
tionis, ad ipsámque perrumpere conabitur, gloria eius opprimetur)
tamen inanis præstantissimarum rerum testimoniis & insignibus relicta
non est. Inuisibiles enim Dei actiones, eiúsque virtus & diuinitas
immortalis, oculis animi facilè subijciuntur cùm ex orbis vniuersi con-
stitutione, ex harmonia & quasi concentu, conseruatione den-

page.notes: Marginal notes as printed: "Hebr. 1. a. 1." (left, beside first paragraph); a manuscript-style mark "ƒ. 8. 47" / "2 Tim. 3. 16." (left margin); "Deut. 4. 2." (left margin); sidenote "De Deo Patre." (left, two lines); "Rom. 1. 19. 20." (left); marginal heading "Argumenta Diuina" (left, two lines). Underlining and pen marks in the text and margins are handwriting and are not transcribed. Several marginal references are partly illegible in the scan; the numbers given are best readings. The word "fuo" at the foot is the catchword. The "s" long s has been rendered as s. Text above the bottom line is cut at the edge of the scan; the final line is taken as printed.
